bips.title: Static Per-Output Miner Fee
bips.description: Bitcoin Improvement Pre-Proposal: a consensus transaction-fee floor of a fixed satoshi amount per new non-coinbase output, pricing permanent UTXO-creation costs that relay policy cannot bind.

related.title: Full Cost of Running a Bitcoin Node
Bitcoin Is Not a Hard Drive

bips.title: Dynamic Escalation of the Per-Output Miner Fee
bips.description: Bitcoin Improvement Pre-Proposal: optional EMA and 25th-percentile fee escalation on top of the static per-output miner fee so the deterrent does not decay over decades.

related.title: Full Cost of Running a Bitcoin Node
Bitcoin Is Not a Hard Drive

bips.title: Permanent Data Channel Closure
bips.description: Bitcoin Improvement Pre-Proposal: permanent consensus closure of data embedding channels (per-item caps, aggregate witness limits, output templates, Tapleaf and P2WSH script analysis) to complement the per-output fee BIPs.
